title: Appointment Scheduling Outreach Calendar: Reminder Days, Channels and Confirmation Calls
content:
The Patient Access Center's outreach calendar for **Appointment Scheduling** sets, for each visit type, the days before the appointment on which reminders go out, the channels used, whether the patient must confirm the appointment from the reminder, and when staff call a patient who has not confirmed.

## Calendar by visit type

| Visit type | Reminder days before the appointment | Reminder channels | Patient confirmation from the reminder | Confirmation call (hours before start) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | 2 | SMS, email, automated call | not required | 0 (no call) |
| Telehealth Video Visit | 1 | SMS, email, automated call | not required | 0 (no call) |
| Specialty New-Patient Consultation | 7 and 2 | SMS, email, automated call | required | 48 |
| Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | 7 and 2 | SMS, email, automated call | required | 48 |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | 3 and 1 | SMS, email, automated call | required | 48 |
| Pre-Admission Testing Appointment | 3 and 1 | SMS, email, automated call | not required | 0 (no call) |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | 7 and 2 | SMS, email, automated call | required | 72 |

## Reading the calendar

- **Reminder days before** lists every day, counted before the appointment, on which a reminder goes out; a visit type with two figures has two reminder days.
- **Reminder channels** are the same three for every visit type: SMS, email and automated call.
- **Confirmation call** gives the hours before the start at which staff call a patient who has not confirmed; a figure of 0 means no call.
- Patient confirmation from the reminder is required for the Specialty New-Patient Consultation, the Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT), the Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment and the Outpatient Procedure Appointment, and for no other visit type; those are also the visit types whose confirmation-call figure is not 0.

## Hypothetical calendar

*Hypothetical:* for an Outpatient Procedure Appointment scheduled on an invented date, reminders go out 7 days and 2 days before that date, and the confirmation-call figure is 72 hours before the start. For a Telehealth Video Visit the reminder goes out 1 day before, and the confirmation-call figure is 0.
